sloka: तत् त्वदीयम् सुरश्रेष्ठः सुराणाम् अग्रतो हि यत् ।अग्र पूजामि इह स्थित्वा गृहाण इदम् विषम् प्रभो ॥१-४५-२४॥
transliteration: tat tvadīyam suraśreṣṭhaḥ surāṇām agrato hi yat ।agra pūjāmi iha sthitvā gṛhāṇa idam viṣam prabho ॥1-45-24॥

translations.english: Hari, smiling said to the tridentbearing Rudra "O Chief of celestial beings you were born the earliest among the devatas. Therefore, while churning the ocean whichever is produced first shall be offered to you. Considering it the first offering, O Lord accept this venom."
translations.hindi: ऐसी शोभा दे रहे थे मानों हंसों के मुंडों से युक्त और इवर- उधर बिखरे हुए शरत्कालीन मेघ, 'आकाश को सुशोभित कर जहे हृ
